name: loweef Crypto Futures Fee Index (fees only)
description: Standard (VIP 0) USDT-margined perpetual futures taker and maker fees by exchange, with the date each row was checked against the exchange and its official source. Fee columns only.

attribution.text: Source: loweef Crypto Futures Fee Index
attribution.html: Source: loweef Crypto Futures Fee Index (CC BY 4.0)

definitions.takerFeePct: Standard (VIP 0) taker fee, percent of notional per fill.
definitions.makerFeePct: Standard (VIP 0) maker fee, percent of notional per fill.
definitions.lastChecked: Date the row was last checked against the exchange. Rows older than 120 days are removed.
definitions.source: Official fee page of the exchange where the row was checked.
definitions.notes: Footnotes on how a value applies (field = the column it explains).

notes.text: Taker 0.04% is the standard rate for the USDT-M BTCUSDT perpetual. MEXC sets futures fees per contract, and this value matches the official fee page (Futures tab, checked 2026-10-14), the public contract API (BTC_USDT, checked 2026-10-08) and the fee charged on a real trade (checked 2026-08-24). Other contracts can differ (for example ETHUSDT taker 0.02%), so a table that lists 0.02% for MEXC may be quoting a different contract.
MEXC may apply a different futures maker fee in some regions (such as parts of Asia, the Middle East, Africa and Latin America). Go by the rate shown on your trading screen.
